title: Accent Expert Gives a Tour of U.S. Accents - (Part 2) | WIRED
summary: Dialect coach Erik Singer tours a range of accents across North America with linguists in Part 2 of WIRED's accent series. It covers regional distinctions such as Southern Mississippi, Miami and Utah English.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an enjoyable, accessible tour of US accents and cite it in threads on vowel shifts and dialects.

quote.text: I loved this video which does a tour of US accents.
